Game Overview

In Idle Store Cleaner, the core idea is straightforward: dive into the life of a mall cleaner in Idle Store Cleaner. Click your way through messes, earn rewards, and upgrade your skills. Experience the thrill of keeping the mall spotless while strategically enhancing your efficiency to tackle ever-growing cleaning challenges with ease.
